A1.title: Academic Research Scout
A1.llm: on demand: specialist session (1 call; quote verified verbatim)
A1.runs: arXiv API queries; in a specialist session an LLM selects one record and extracts a claim

A2.title: Strategy Discovery Scout
A2.runs: arXiv API queries with strategy-oriented terms

A3.title: Evidence Verification Agent
A3.runs: re-fetch + Crossref match + rule-based evidence grade

A4.title: Novelty and Deduplication Agent
A4.runs: mechanism signatures compared with all earlier hypotheses

C1.title: Trend and Momentum Researcher
C1.llm: optional: 1 budgeted call per cycle, deterministic template fallback
C1.runs: hypothesis extraction from one source within a fixed template

C2.title: Mean-Reversion Researcher
C2.llm: optional: 1 budgeted call per cycle, deterministic template fallback (never activated so far)

C3.title: Microstructure Researcher
C3.llm: optional: 1 budgeted call per cycle, deterministic template fallback

C4.title: Strategy Synthesis Agent
C4.runs: policy rule: combine only validated mechanisms

D3.title: Test Engineering Agent
D3.runs: static check, causality probe, determinism replay

E1.title: Backtesting Scientist
E1.runs: delegates to the research lab (premises, screen, walk-forward)

E3.title: Adversarial Researcher
E3.llm: optional critique (1 call per cycle / per specialist session)
E3.runs: falsification battery; the LLM critique is advisory and never changes a status

F1.title: Chief Research Orchestrator
F1.runs: durable task DAG, budgets, retries, pause/stop (army orchestrator + ops scheduler)

F3.title: Risk and Reliability Researcher
F3.runs: tail risk; drift of resolved prospective forecasts

F4.title: Evolution Coordinator
F4.llm: never (role registry previously said llm_optional; corrected)
F4.runs: ranks next experiments by a fixed prior/cost rule

G1.title: Quantitative Research Scientist
G1.llm: on demand: specialist session (1 call; citations and duplicates checked)
G1.runs: forecast-link feature tests; in a specialist session an LLM proposes one hypothesis

G4.title: Statistical Arbitrage Scientist
G4.runs: NOT implemented: records the data gap

H3.title: Multi-Scale Cycle Scientist
H3.runs: stability checks across years and halves

I2.title: Monetary Policy Scientist
I2.runs: federalreserve.gov + FRED ingestion, FOMC event study

I3.title: Economic Calendar Scientist
I3.runs: BLOCKED: records the CPI/NFP/GDP data gap

I4.title: Geopolitical and Cross-Asset Scientist
I4.runs: cross-asset election responses; geopolitics not ingested

not_operational_as_llm_agents.Strategy Designer: C1-C3 formulate within reviewed templates; no free-form strategy design by an LLM (bounded budget, overfitting risk)
not_operational_as_llm_agents.Engineering Agent: D2 renders templates; LLM-written code would need an isolated worktree + human review per change (codeprop exists for proposals) - not enabled in this slice
not_operational_as_llm_agents.Evolution Coordinator: F4 is a deterministic ranking rule; no LLM involved

note: the 256 simulated agents are market participants inside the simulator, not researchers
